experiment: HomePulse state residential electricity forecasting feasibility
status: Separate experiment; no changes to the existing HomePulse app
population: All 50 US states plus Washington DC, all available months from January 2010 to August 2026
target: Monthly residential electricity sales to ultimate customers, MWh
target_limitation: State aggregate grid electricity sales, not an individual household's consumption or total behind-the-meter consumption
feature_information_cutoff: For target month t, sales observations must be dated t-3 or earlier
evaluation: Retrospective rolling-input backtest using current revised data; model coefficients remain fixed during evaluation. Assumes t-3 observations are published before t. Not a vintage/as-issued operational backtest.
boundary_gap_reason: Allows time for training/validation labels to be published before the first scored target; no target labels from later evaluation months are used to fit or select the model
selection: Choose XGBoost candidate with lowest mean of state-specific WAPE on validation; select the strongest simple baseline by the same validation metric. Evaluate these choices once on the test period. Do not tune to test results.
metrics: number of states improved relative to validation-selected baseline
outliers: Do not delete, cap or select households/states/months based on forecast errors or target magnitude
readiness: High pooled R2 alone is insufficient. Investigate per-state errors, baseline skill, publication timing and prediction uncertainty before replacing the household app. No R2 threshold is promised.
